transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. Well, I guess I'm here because my mind just won't stay on one thing anymore. It's been messing me up at work. I'll be at the bench and... I don't know, I just jump from reading a customer email to staring at a saw mark on a piece, or listening to some noise outside. And then I realize I've completely lost the whole work order. So... yeah. That's mostly it.
Do you find it hard to focus on a task for as long as you used to?

Yeah, I guess so. It's... it's like I'll stare at a repair ticket, or maybe a tray of sapphires, and I just can't hold the measurements in my head. Not long enough to actually decide what to do next. It just slips away.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?

I don't know about fidgety. I just... I've been doing a lot. Like, I had to get everything moving all at once. I started lining up a bunch of new commissions, messaging old customers... I even started sketching out this whole new Appalachian collection and planning a website for it. Just... doing a lot of things at the same time, I guess.
Are you having trouble getting along with friends or family because of these issues with focus and restlessness?

Um... I guess so. My family's been... they've been checking in on me a lot lately. They say I'm not doing my usual routines and they're worried. And... well, I kind of messed up at the shop. I completely missed a deadline for a big custom piece. Everything just got so disorganized that I... I had to stop taking new orders for a bit.
Have you been feeling anxious or stressed out lately?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I wouldn't say I feel anxious. I haven't really thought about it. Just... doing a lot, like I said.
How long have you been experiencing these difficulties with focus and restlessness?
Um... I'd say... about two weeks. It started right after this jewelry show. I got an award, and... well, that whole wired stretch just went on for a couple of weeks after that.
Are these problems with focus and restlessness causing you a lot of distress?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I wouldn't call it distress. It's just... stuff that's happening. I'm fine.
Have you had to cut back on any activities or responsibilities because of these problems with focus and restlessness?

Um... yeah, I guess a little. I... I missed a deadline for a big custom piece. And my shop records are just... a mess right now. So I had to stop taking new orders. Just for a bit. My family's been calling more, too. I think they noticed I wasn't really doing my normal stuff. But it's fine.
Are you having trouble keeping up with your work or daily responsibilities because of your difficulties with focus and restlessness?
I mean... like I just said. With the shop, and missing that deadline. That's my work. But other than that... no, I don't think so. Just what I told you.
Have you been acting on impulse more often than usual?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I've been doing anything like that. Just... normal stuff.
Are you finding it difficult to manage your daily life because of these problems with focus and restlessness?

I... I feel like I just answered this. 

Like I said, it's mostly just the shop. I missed that custom delivery, and my records got so messed up I had to stop taking new work for now. And... yeah, my family's been checking on me more because they're worried I slipped out of my routine. 

I don't really have anything else to add to that.
Have these problems with focus and restlessness gone away at all since they started two weeks ago?
Um... well, it lasted for about two weeks. That whole... wired stretch. It started right after I got an award at this jewelry show, and it just... kept going for those two weeks. So... yeah.
Have you always had a hard time focusing or been overly active, even as a child?
No... not really. I don't think so. I was just... a normal kid, I guess. It wasn't a problem back then.
Have you ever had a period of time in your life when you didn't have these problems with focus and restlessness?
Yeah... I mean, mostly I'm fine. It was just... just those two weeks where it was like that. Usually, I can focus just fine on my work.
Have you noticed any changes in your relationships with friends or family since these focus and restlessness issues started?

Um... I guess things have been a little strained. My family... they've been calling a lot more. Checking in. I think they got worried because I wasn't really doing my normal routine. And... well, work got pretty messed up. I missed a big delivery for a custom piece, and... my paperwork just got completely disorganized. I actually had to stop taking new orders for a bit just to... try and sort it out. So, yeah. It's affected things.
Have you needed help from others to manage your daily tasks since these issues started?

Um... like I was just saying, my family has been checking on me a lot more. They got pretty worried about how far I slipped from my usual routines, so they try to help keep me on track. But with the shop... no, I haven't really had help. I just had to stop taking new work for now because my records are a mess and I missed that major custom delivery. So... yeah. Mostly just my family calling.
Have you had any significant problems at work or in your personal relationships that you think are directly because of these focus and restlessness issues?

I mean... yeah, I just told you. It's... work is a mess. I missed that custom delivery. My records are all over the place, so I had to stop taking new orders. And... my family keeps calling because they're worried I'm not doing my normal stuff. So... yeah, it's caused problems.
Have you ever had any problems with impulsivity, such as interrupting others or blurting out answers?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think I do that.
Did you have any problems with focus or restlessness as a child that were similar to what you're experiencing now?
Um... no. Not that I remember. I was just... a regular kid, I guess. I didn't really have issues like this back then.
Have you experienced significant symptoms of inattention and hyperactivity in multiple settings, such as at work and at home?
Um... I mean, I guess so? Like I said, work is messed up right now. And my family's worried. So... yeah, it's happening in both places.
